task_instance: Analyze options flow for a single watchlist ticker (CEG): record provider/retrieval metadata, paginate the full options chain, compute raw put/call ratio by session volume, apply the explicit heuristic filter (OTM, premium < $0.10/share, absolute delta < 0.05), compute the filtered put/call ratio with excluded-share breakdown by side and expiry, and flag anomalies vs a 30-day baseline.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires live options chain data (snapshots, quotes and per-contract Greeks) pulled from a commercial options data provider that mandates an authorized provider credential held in a private secret store and a paid plan with entitlements for snapshots/quotes/Greeks (see the skill's Requirements and Limitations sections). I have no such credential or account, the provider host is a placeholder I cannot reach, and this run forbids web fetch/search, so I cannot retrieve the chain. The run rules also forbid fabricating the data the provider would return, and the per-contract chain (volume, open interest, premium, delta, expiry) is provider-fetched output rather than input a user would hand over, so creating a synthetic chain to compute against is not permitted. Without the provider-sourced chain there is no real deliverable to produce or verify.
evidence: Read the skill at plugins/agentic-awesome-skills/skills/options-flow-analyzer/SKILL.md. It computes raw and filtered put/call ratios, excluded-share breakdowns, per-expiry buckets and anomaly flags from a live options chain. Steps 1-5 all operate on a paginated selected chain that comes from the data provider named only as a placeholder; the Requirements section states 'Authorized provider credential in a private host secret store; verify current plan entitlements for snapshots, quotes and Greeks', and Limitations states data availability depends on the paid plan. No bundled script or sample chain ships with the skill. The only data path (credentialed provider over the network) is unavailable: no credential/account, placeholder host, and web access disallowed this run. Per the run's anti-fabrication rule I did not synthesize a stand-in chain. result.json written to the work directory; no chain file produced because none could be legitimately obtained.
